description: This Java source file defines the class TaxAuthorityServices, which provides services related to tax calculations, including product tax rate calculations for display and general tax adjustments, within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving tax adjustments, handling tax exemptions, and querying tax authority data based on geographic regions and product categories.

classes.name: TaxAuthorityServices
classes.description: Provides tax calculation services including product tax rate calculations for display and general tax adjustments within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalcForDisplay
methods.description: Calculates the total tax, tax percentage, and price with tax for a product, intended for display purposes, based on product and store data.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalc
methods.description: Calculates tax adjustments for a list of products in an order, considering shipping, promotions, and geographic tax authorities.

methods.name: getTaxAuthorities
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax authorities based on shipping address geographic regions.

methods.name: getTaxAdjustments
methods.description: Generates tax adjustment entries based on product, store, and geographic data, including handling exemptions.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Fetches the product price for a given product, store, and tax authority context.

methods.name: setProductCategoryCond
methods.description: Determines the product category condition for tax calculations based on product variant status.

methods.name: handlePartyTaxExempt
methods.description: Handles tax exemption logic for a party, including inheritance from parent tax authorities.
